description: Machine-readable research ledger for external repositories and extractable mechanisms. Unknown facts remain PENDING. No invented revisions or mechanisms. Mechanism entries below are inventory placeholders pending source-level audit of the referenced repositories.

repositories.name: slowhttptest
repositories.notes: Public Application Layer DoS simulator (Apache-2.0). Queued for mechanism-level extraction only. No claims about internal symbols until source audit at a pinned revision.

repositories.name: GoldenEye
repositories.notes: HTTP stress test tool (Keep-Alive + NoCache vector). Alternate Go port exists (zvdy/goldeneye). Queued for mechanism-level extraction only. Pin revision before AUDITED.

mechanisms.name: connection-lifecycle-control
mechanisms.description: How connections are opened, held, and closed under prolonged partial HTTP exchange.
mechanisms.notes: Extract lifecycle states only; do not port attack orchestration.

mechanisms.name: connection-rate-control
mechanisms.description: Connections-per-second and ramp behaviour for opening sockets.
mechanisms.notes: Compare with load2 SmartPaceController / MaxConcurrency model after audit.

mechanisms.name: partial-slow-io
mechanisms.description: Partial write / slow read patterns and interval between follow-up data.
mechanisms.notes: Relevant only as controlled lab diagnostic of server timeout behaviour under authorization.

mechanisms.name: timeout-and-probe-model
mechanisms.description: Probe connection timeout, test duration limits, and failure detection.

mechanisms.name: worker-concurrency-model
mechanisms.description: How concurrent connections/workers are bounded and scheduled.

mechanisms.name: scenario-parametrization
mechanisms.description: CLI/config parameters that define test shape (verb, interval, duration, connection count).

mechanisms.name: measurement-and-reporting
mechanisms.description: What is measured (sockets, service impact, timing) and how results are reported.

mechanisms.name: worker-socket-pool
mechanisms.description: Workers vs sockets concurrency model (defaults historically workers=50, sockets=30).
mechanisms.notes: Audit actual source before treating defaults as evidence.

mechanisms.name: http-method-and-header-variation
mechanisms.description: GET/POST/random method selection and header/user-agent variation for request diversity.
mechanisms.notes: Reusable as scenario diversity only inside authorized load2 bounds.

mechanisms.name: keepalive-session-reuse
mechanisms.description: HTTP Keep-Alive usage for connection persistence across requests.
mechanisms.notes: Map against load2 persistent SMTP session model only at mechanism level.

mechanisms.name: multiprocess-or-worker-scheduling
mechanisms.description: Process/thread/worker scheduling and shutdown behaviour under load.

mechanisms.name: ssl-verification-policy
mechanisms.description: Optional disable of SSL certificate verification and related TLS client policy.
mechanisms.notes: Any adaptation must preserve explicit security policy in load2; default-safe behaviour required.
